research: Slate line Gonzaga -27.5; homeSpreadClose -29.5 (open -27.5): the market moved 2 points toward Gonzaga by tip (slate file). Close treated as fair; slate-vs-close not used as a reason.
Total moved from 148.5 to 151.5 (slate file); Predictem's writer still played the Under 151.5, citing a slow, grinding game (predictem.com, 2026-11-07).
Gonzaga opened with a 78-72 win over Purdue in Las Vegas, a 6-point game against a high-major (predictem.com, 2026-11-07). Helps neither side much; shows Gonzaga is good but its opener was close.
Xaivian Lee scored 18 in the opener; Braden Huff went 4-of-11 for 10 (predictem.com, 2026-11-07). Neutral.

Gonzaga rated in KenPom's top dozen with an adjusted margin around +25; New Mexico State about No. 131 (predictem.com, 2026-11-07). Rating math (~+22 neutral plus home court) lands around Gonzaga by 25-26: slightly New Mexico State.

[angle] New Mexico State's best preseason player, Gabe Warren, tore his ACL nine minutes into the opener and is out for the season (predictem.com, 2026-11-07). Helps Gonzaga, though it happened days before this line was posted, so likely priced.
[angle] KK Robinson is on a minutes restriction after back-to-back ACL tears, and Stephon Payne faces eligibility uncertainty (predictem.com, 2026-11-07). Helps Gonzaga: a thin Aggie rotation.
[angle] Coach Jason Hooten told the Spokesman-Review the roster is compromised (paraphrased in predictem.com, 2026-11-07). Helps Gonzaga.
New Mexico State beat Division II Western New Mexico only 73-66 in its opener (predictem.com, 2026-11-07). A weak showing: helps Gonzaga.

[angle] The preview notes Gonzaga tends to settle into half-court possessions and empty the bench once a lead is safe, which compresses blowout margins (predictem.com, 2026-11-07). Helps New Mexico State.
Predictem's projection was Gonzaga 82-58 (24 points) and its side lean was New Mexico State +27.5 (predictem.com, 2026-11-07). Preview picks are priced; tiebreaker at most for New Mexico State.
Home opener at McCarthey Athletic Center after a neutral-site opener in Las Vegas (predictem.com, 2026-11-07). Neutral.
games.reasoning: The ratings put Gonzaga around a 25-26 point favorite, but New Mexico State's roster is thinner than its rating after Warren's injury and it barely beat a D-II team, so I project about 26.5: within roughly a point of the number, a pass. The forced side is New Mexico State on Gonzaga's bench-clearing habit in a game the market expects to be slow; a Gonzaga press or hot start would sink it.
